summary: Best Buy's holiday push leans on creators: a new TikTok Shop storefront where creators tag Best Buy products, plus shopping through ChatGPT.
Partnerize talked up an integration with AI-visibility tool Profound and argued delivery-app consolidation doesn't stop discovery happening everywhere else.
CJ posted on using data rather than guesswork to set opening commission offers.
Other partner posts (Apple Books, Wordery, Rakuten, retailer LinkedIn pages) were routine and left out.

items.title: Best Buy is using football, TikTok creators and ChatGPT to get your holiday shopping dollars
items.why: Best Buy is selling through TikTok Shop and ChatGPT as well as its own site, so its products are reachable from more places than ever.
